hypothesis: Test bn-adamw relative to the BatchNorm control under a fixed 30-epoch limit.
test_policy: Training and original validation only; do not load test images or use test metrics.
comparison_note: Adaptive development search selected on original validation; no test access. Compare with same-architecture BatchNorm control. Each individual arm changes activation, depth, or optimizer; AdamW also introduces a declared decay choice.
stopping_rule: At most 30 epochs, five non-improving validation macro-F1 epochs, or 300 seconds checked between epochs. Final checkpoint verification and training-fit evaluation can add overhead.
